A '''mono-cord whip''' was a [[Whip (weapon)|whip]] that was used by the enforcers of the [[Galentro Heavy Works]] corporation. They were a very destructive weapon, made of strands of [[Monofilament cable]], and able to cut through skin, cloth, and medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. <ref name="{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}} ">''{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}''</ref>
